'''Pecto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], Pecto also shared his knowledge of underworld trading with others. He wore [[Color/Legends|white and red]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].
